column1: # config/assets.tsv -- the game's creative content: data a unit defines whose initialiser the build takes from the
# cartridge, so that the repository carries no puzzle, credit or picture of the game.  The owning unit keeps the
# definition (its name, type and place) and #includes "assets/FILE" at it; the gate has datagen write FILE from
# the ROM into $WOF_BUILD/assets before it compiles, and counts the range as asset bytes, never as bytes from
# source.  The header of tools/datagen.c ("Assets") defines what a file holds.
# Columns: start, end (exclusive), owner (the unit that defines the datum), type (as datagen takes it; "ELEM
# strings" for a run of static ELEM arrays, one definition a string), file (under $WOF_BUILD/assets), what.
